# Lavendar Lewis & Paul Irving

- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — Relative of — [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — stepmother, calls her Mother Lavendar · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.People P4](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0004)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses in a new pale green dress and converses with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md) before leaving for [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) then walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they eat lunch and visit with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) in the garden. Afterward, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) set out to pick early strawberries for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P37](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0037)_

> [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) expresses concern to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Miss Lavendar's unusual despondency and apathy. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises to come stay for a week during her vacation to help cheer Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) up. Meanwhile, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) bond over their shared experiences with imaginary dream-people before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)_

> After school finishes, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and meets his returning father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to pass a message to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the note to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and helps her prepare for Stephen's arrival that evening.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P42](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0042), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and is shocked to learn from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. She spends a grief-stricken night realizing her deep love for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and fearing for his life. At dawn, she speaks with [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md), who tells her that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) passed the crisis and will recover.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v3 ch.Revelation P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025)_
